dct_description_sm: This polygon data layer represents the 15 City of Milwaukee aldermanic districts for 2024. The source portal states that district boundaries are revised every ten years. The source shapefile is projected in NAD27 / Wisconsin South (EPSG:32054).
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
